headline: Muted quarter ly results, guides for strong H2’FY27

highlights: Reported EBITDA stood at ~₹52 crore with corresponding EBITDA margins at ~14.3% (down 176 bps QoQ).
Consolidated PAT for the quarter stood at ₹26 crore (flat YoY).
Investment Rationale: • Robust volume growth guidance to support long - term earnings growth : VPT reported muted performance in H1FY27 with near 8% volume growth.
Encouragingly however, the company has maintained its guidance of 15% volume growth for FY27, implying ~20% volume growth in H2FY27.
valuation: Rating and Target Price : We maintain a positive view on Venus (VPT), supported by healthy double-digit volume-led earnings growth over the medium term, along with increasing presence in high-growth segments such as Data Centre, along with a growing portfolio of niche value-added product offerings, a net debt free/cash surplus B/S and healthy double digit return ratios.
We reiterate our BUY rating on stock with a target price of ₹2, 34 0, i.e. ~30x PE on FY28E.
ICICI Direct assigns ratings to its stocks according to their notional target price vs. current market price and then categorizes them as Buy, Hold, Reduce and Sell.
watch: Furthermore, spooling and fittings operations are expected to contribute ₹70/~₹45 crores to the revenue in FY27, respectively, highlighting topline growth visibility in H2FY27. • Equity Raise : The company recently executed an equity raise (preferential allotment) worth ₹372 crores, primarily earmarked for debt repayment resulting in notable derisking of balance sheet.
Investments in securities market are subject to market risks.
